summary: s is the local Artin image of an idele x at w of order −k; the avatar at s is ιℓ of the character at x, which, the character being unramified at w, is its value at the uniformiser to the power k.

steps.claim: Since s⁻¹ acts on residues as the (q_w)^k-th power, s is the local Artin symbol at A of some x ∈ E_w^× of valuation k (v(x) = exp(−k) in multiplicative notation).
steps.lean: choose z _ e using a.exists_localArtin_eq h k

steps.claim: Hence chiOneInv O (s) = ιℓ(θ(x)) for the algebraic character θ = bc(a⁻¹)·υ^{|r|}·|·|^{|r|/2} of chiOneInv (avatar_localArtin, w not above ℓ); θ is unramified at w, so θ(x) = θ(ϖ_w)^k (apply_locIdele_eq_zpow); unfolding frobValue, spaceChar and toAlgebraic, θ(ϖ_w) = ν_w⁻¹, and the remaining identity is ring arithmetic.
steps.lean:
simp [avatar_localArtin _ a _ e, ↓CharUnramifiedAt.apply_locIdele_eq_zpow _ z, *, frobValue,
    AutChar.spaceChar, HasWeight.toAlgebraic,
